notes.title: Announcing: Takara Cards!
notes.notes:
[h3]Our new game is called Takara Cards:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932210/

[b]Takara Cards[/b] is a tactical Deck Builder with light RPG elements. It takes place in the same universe as our first game, NEXT JUMP: Shmup Tactics and is being made on the Godot Engine!

The team is formed by [url=https://oswaldoaugusto.com/]Daniel Pinheiro (art, animation, ui)[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/filipedilly]Filipe Dilly (design, code, producer)[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/keikoucha/]Kawakeiko (art, art direction)[/url]. Music by [url=https://oieusouorafa.bandcamp.com/]Rafael Assunção [/url].

[h3]For more details, here's our first announcement on the Steam forums:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1932210/view/4564966873078265240

Hope you find the game interesting! :)

notes.title: Afternoon Delights update is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786877/357094d5355b97c2e5a46afb69cd040db54c91a6.png[/img]

[h1]"Afternoon Delights" adds to the game a huge amount of content, including:[/h1]
Virtually all the houses now have three different variations:
Morning/Noon, Afternoon and Night, as opposed to just two of the original game (day and night).
Not only are there more variations per house, but the stories that happen are more engaging and connected to each other.

[b]16 new Endings![/b] Now all the houses have endings and there are more types of endings present in the game: More shades of sadness, despair and happiness (yes happiness!)!
We have also improved the interface of the "sales/answer cards": Now, after seeing an End, the answer card that leads to that end will have a different color from the other cards.

[b]A new secret house! Try to find it! :)[/b]

[b]6 new achievements![/b]

[b]Steam Leaderboards![/b] We implemented the Sunny Morning rating and ranking system that evaluates the best (and worst) sellers in the world!

[b]Russian Translation![/b]

Other minor improvements:
- Now the "Sunny Capacitor" item also acts as a "second chance" in the game: if the player finds an End and owns a capacitor the game will ask if he or she wants to go back in time and continue the game.
- We changed the game Fonts to support Russian and have better readability.
- Several English typos have been fixed in the game.
- Several minor bugs have been fixed.
- Several minor improvements.

[h1]The game's soundtrack is now available on BandCamp:[/h1]
https://oieusouorafa.bandcamp.com/album/talk-to-strangers-ost

[b]We hope you enjoy the update and don't forget, smile! :)[/b]

notes.title: First game update! (build 165)
notes.notes:
[b]Good morning sellers![/b]

Here are the notes of the first update:

- Changes in the system of "unlocking houses". Now after the player makes 2 different endings or survives all week, the houses unlock ONE DAY before (except the Abyss). This results in greater flexibility at the beginning of the game and possibly less sensation of repetition.
- Reduced the number of finals needed to unlock the achievement '' Veni, vidi, perdidi '' for 5. We made 20 different finals to create a more interesting narrative, with surprises (and jokes) for the player, not to force anyone to play.
- Changes in the night sprites of the "Loud House".
- Improved sound of the "Sunny Ball" Item (important).
- Solved problem where some players could not download the game on Linux and Mac.
- Fixed bug where the bottom of the Abyss did not animate.
- Some typos and text adjustments.

If you find any problems, please report on the forum.

Thanks for everyone who has played the game! :)

[i]See ya! And have a sunny life!™[/i]

notes.title: More about the game!
notes.notes:
Hello!

[b]Talk to Strangers[/b] is [i]based / inspired / spiritual successor[/i] to another game called "Don't Talk to Strangers". "Don't Talk" was made during the [i]Stencyl Game Jam 2016[/i] and we were impressed by the positive feedback from the players. Inspired by this positive feedback we decided to invest in the ideas and mechanics developed in it, as well as expand on those ideas!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786877/b21464424f68d62a878d0d1a2e5f672a3a4941d8.jpg[/img]

That's how Talk to Strangers was born! But instead of playing as child knocking from door to door begging for candy, you play as a [b]salesman[/b] trying to sell products from house to house.
In fact, for those who have played Do not Talk, this new game is happening in the same city! Even with characters appearing again!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786877/c22f5ddc7d3b94695038bebd8d39ad40fd8cc354.jpg[/img]

For those who have not played Don't Talk to Strangers, it's available for free here (for all platforms):
 [url=https://postmortempixels.itch.io/dont-talk-to-strangers] Don't Talk to Strangers on itchio [/url] 

Talk to Strangers is also the first Post Mortem Pixels game made in conjunction with other artists / designers:
Luis Felipe Garrocho (design, writing and original idea), Ricardo Tokumoto (Art Direction and Pixel art), Daniel Pinheiro Lima (Pixel art, animation and writing).  In addition to the songs of Rafael Assunção, who created the NEXT JUMP OST! :)

If you have any questions about the game, just ask!
Thank you!
